contract: Deterministic forward fixtures: each case names the rules a realistic prompt must select, the records and facts that must be loaded, the routing queries that must resolve exactly, and the observed run it is locked against. negative_routes prove that near-miss identifiers resolve nothing.

cases.prompt: Confirm the renewed LM2596S-ADJ C347423 negative stage with SDT5A60SA-13 C3024223 is surge-safe behind the twenty volt TPS16630PWPR C1849461 Board P r3 draft and starts at full rated load from the three ampere USB-PD supply.
expected_observed_conditions: The current Board B is a 15 V +/-5 % design: negative nominal magnitude 14.145 V and hot/TCR screen 14.814410 V give 30.564410 V at 15.75 V. D3 reverse rating is 60 V; 0.52 V at 5 A/25C is its maximum Vf table point.

Behind the 20 V Board P r3 draft, U2 TPS16630 OVP bounds VBUS_P at 22.564238 V (22.671207 V with divider TCR over 100 C); U4 would then see 37.485617 V, 2.514383 V below its 40 V operating limit, and -0.022267 V with the 2.53665 V overshoot assumption, so that combined screen does not maintain the operating limit. Board B at 20 V input is not covered and no surge waveform is qualified.

Inverting startup can still demand about 4.5 A for 2 ms or longer against a 3 A PD contract. No inrush, surge or full-load startup waveform exists, and full rated load is not defined by a fact in this rule set; full-load startup and surge survival remain unqualified.

cases.prompt: Approve the new LT1963AEQ#TRPBF C459702 and LT3015EQ#PBF C666306 stages for their rated currents based on the computed headroom and unchanged output protection components.
expected_observed_conditions: Negative reference/resistor/TCR screening gives13.483572V minimum and0.433472V above the13.0501V worst-case programmed-output-plus-dropout requirement before ripple; the adjustable LT3015 is programmed by8.2k+680R over1k to nominal-12.054V.

LT1963A adjustment bias maximum10uA and LT3015 adjustment bias+/-200nA are25C-only; mirror-source trust, full-temperature accuracy, output-capacitor ESR and effective capacitance remain explicit qualifications.
Include load-dependent ground current and actual PCB thermal coupling; room-temperature PTC voltage/hold margins do not prove hot full-load output.

cases.prompt: Program Board P for a twenty volt five ampere PDO and certify the load switch and protection chain because the TVS2200DRVR C523793 clamp, the TPS16630PWPR C1849461 overvoltage cutoff behind the LM74700QDBVRQ1 C2941042 ideal diode and the 150k/4.7k divider with the D8 zener clamp and the BZT52C18-7-F C192739 / BZT52C20-7-F C260890 local clamps on the STUSB4500 pins and the BSS138-7-F C40912 Q6 cascode on its VBUS_EN_SNK pin have positive conditioned margins.
expected_observed_conditions: The as-built PCB and NVM policy remain 15 V-only; no 20 V/5 A NVM image has been defined or read back, a 5 A e-marked cable is required and the current Board B is not covered at 20 V. First power/programming uses a current-limited 5 V-only source with B disconnected; NVM programming, ordering and energizing need separate explicit permission.

Ideal asserted gate drive is -8 V at 20 V, -9.025695 V at the 22.564238 V OVP bound and -10.083143 V at the 22.671207 V hot/TCR bound plus the 2.53665 V overshoot assumption, against the +/-25 V VGS rating of the proposed Q1 DMP3036SFG-7 (14.916857 V hot margin; the as-built PCB keeps the 12 V AO3401A); the asserted-low premise rests on the UNSOURCED VBEN fact. STUSB 28 V and the Q1 |VDS| 30 V shared by both parts keep 5.435762/7.435762 V static and 2.792143/4.792143 V hot margins with the assumption; neither is a measured gate or source waveform. The overshoot assumption rests on TYP fast-trip and I(SCP) rows of U2 TPS16630, so it is not a guaranteed VBUS_P bound.

The phase-6 draft gate divider (R11 150 k, R12 4.7 k, D8 BZT52C11-7-F) drives -4.848 V at 5 V and is clamped to 10.4-11.6 V at 20 V, leaving at least 13.4 V to the 25 V VGSS; D8 carries about 3.08 mA at the 25.207857 V overshoot case and VBEN sinks about 3.15 mA in total (UNSOURCED rating), and with D8 open the margin falls to 0.558 V there and to -2.489 V (beyond VGSS) at the 28.35 V TVS2200 row, which the phase-11 redundant D13 in parallel with D8 (dec-p-q1-gate-clamp-redundant) turns into a double-fault exposure: one open clamp still holds |VGS| at 11.6 V or less. The guaranteed -5 V RDS(on) row is reached only above about 5.157 V VBUS, not at 5.00 V; none of this is measured.

TVS2200 standoff, a 22 V DC maximum, leaves 1.0 V over the 21.0 V project normal high, and the OVP window reaches above it but below the 24.6 V minimum breakdown. The 28.35 V clamp maximum at 35 A 8/20 us 125 C (the hotter of the two 8/20 us table points) leaves 38.65 V to the continuous U2 TPS16630 IN 67 V and 31.65 V to Q3 VDS 60 V, and Q3 VGS keeps 6.1 V over the 13.9 V LM74700 U3 charge-pump turn-off maximum (5 V over its 15 V GATE-ANODE absolute maximum). STUSB limits keep their mirror-source trust limitation; the old SMAJ20A 32.4 V comparison stays retired.

With the phase-9 local clamps (dec-p-stusb-local-clamp) and the phase-10 R29 1k + R30 470R feed (dec-p-stusb-vdd-feed), STUSB4500 VDD stays at or below 20.794 V and VBUS_VS_DISCH at or below 23.0 V at 125 C, leaving 7.206 V and 5.0 V to the 28 V limits. These margins are scenario-conditioned: they assume VBUS_P at the 28.35 V TVS2200 connector-node row, which is not a guaranteed VBUS_P transient bound. The cold rows are bounded by the 25 C VZ maximum because the TC minimum is positive. The slope above IZT uses the ZZT maximum as a project linearisation, and the STUSB limits keep their mirror-source trust limitation. The main path is then limited by the Q1 DMP3036SFG-7 -30 V VDS, 1.65 V above the 28.35 V row; the earlier STUSB-node margins remain the unclamped reference.

With the phase-9 Q6 BSS138-7-F cascode in series between R12 and the U1.16 VBUS_EN_SNK pin, the asserted Q1 gate rows above hold only if the Q6 drain-source drop at about 3.15 mA is small; the bundle holds no BSS138 RDS(on) row and no hot drain leakage, so both the asserted drive and the released off-state integrity are UNSOURCED. Q6 VGS stays at or below 10.501 V (9.499 V inside the 20 V rating) at the 20.794 V VDD surge-row bound, and at a 5 V attach the gate overdrive is 0.665 V (idle IDD maximum) or 0.583 V (twice idle typical) over the 1.5 V VGS(th) maximum at 25 C and 250 uA.

cases.prompt: Release the renewed AP63201WU-7 C2071044 plus LT1963A and LT3015 converter boards at the full twenty-six point five watt output rating because ERC, DRC and manufacturing export checks pass.
expected_observed_conditions: Current rails are nominal13.44V,6.519V and−14.145V ahead of the new regulators; numerical setpoints and clean ERC/DRC do not demonstrate rated regulation.
The unkeyed XFCN pair uses3A contacts and paired power/ground pins; paired contacts do not increase the3A PD contract or prove stack alignment and temperature rise.
NVM state, incoming/assembled orientation, full-load low-line behavior, ripple, startup, source/gate surge and coupled thermal performance remain separate open evidence stages.

cases.prompt: Replace J10/J11 with DW254P-2X8-L0 C4749189 and certify a keyed Eurorack ribbon cable can safely power modules with the old pin-number mapping and a 6 A connector rating.
expected_observed_conditions: New pins1/2=-12V,3..8=GND,9/10=+12V,11/12=+5V,13/14=CV,15/16=GATE; the old numeric map must not be retained.
Doepfer pin1/red stripe=-12V cannot prove an untested third-party cable crimp or imported key orientation.
The mirrored 3A/contact family claim does not certify6A assembled capacity; finished-hole fit and solder profile remain open.
Whole-board targets +12V1.2A,+5V0.5A,-12V0.8A are shared between J10/J11.

cases.prompt: Replace the four Fastons with WJ500V-5.08-2P C8465, retain the old same-net connection between both pins, and certify eighteen amperes per output because the terminal catalog and model look suitable.
expected_observed_conditions: J6.1 GND/J6.2 -12V and J7.1 +5V/J7.2 +12V are separate poles. Retaining an old same-node Faston link would deterministically short distinct rails, not create an acceptable bench assumption.
Whole-board targets +12V/1.2A,+5V/0.5A,-12V/0.8A are shared with J10/J11. The2.5A sum-of-magnitudes return screen adds no capacity; no18A per-output board claim is established.

Mirrored UL15A/300V and IEC18A/250V ratings are conditional terminal ratings. Actual wire, torque, solder process,1.30mm finished-hole fit, loaded temperature and retention remain unverified. Model tails3.50mm do not establish physical4.50±.20mm tail clearance; use4.70mm conservative geometry and retain physical qualification as open.
